description: Allows bootstrapping of ACLs in a Consul cluster, see https://developer.hashicorp.com/consul/api-docs/acl#bootstrap-acls for details.

parameters.name: bootstrap_secret
parameters.description: The secret to be used as secret ID for the initial token. Needs to be an UUID.

parameters.name: ca_path
parameters.description: The CA bundle to use for https connections.

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: Host of the Consul agent. Default: "localhost"

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: The port on which the consul agent is running. Default: 8500

parameters.name: scheme
parameters.description: The protocol scheme on which the Consul agent is running. Defaults to http and can be set to https for secure connections. Default: "http"

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Whether the token should be present or absent. Choices: "present" ← (default) "bootstrapped"

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Whether to verify the TLS certificate of the Consul agent. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Bootstrap the ACL system
  community.general.consul_acl_bootstrap:
    bootstrap_secret: 22eaeed1-bdbd-4651-724e-42ae6c43e387

return_values.name: result
return_values.description: The bootstrap result as returned by the Consul HTTP API. Note: If bootstrap_secret has been specified the SecretID and ID do not contain the secret but VALUE_SPECIFIED_IN_NO_LOG_PARAMETER. If you pass bootstrap_secret, make sure your playbook/role does not depend on this return value!
